//resolutions: `@vue/test-utils` pulls `js-beautify` only to pretty-print snapshots, and
its newer releases drag in `editorconfig@3`, `minimatch@10` and `nopt@10`,
each of which demands Node 20 or later. The bench in WSL runs Node 18 and
builds ERPNext's assets with it, so raising Node there to satisfy a test
formatter is the wrong end of the problem to pull. Pinning the formatter
to its last Node-18 line costs nothing: it is not in the app bundle and
not in a single assertion. Remove when the bench moves to Node 20.
